title: wb migrate carries a markdown table as one multi-line item, so the table no longer renders
body:
`intent wb migrate` carries a markdown table as ONE item whose text is every line of the table. hv's six rulings of 2026-08-24 on devbin's hv board were a table; they are now decision `seq 2`, an eight-line item rendered as a bullet whose first line is the header row and whose other seven are continuation lines, so the table no longer renders. Its caption and trailer became decision items `seq 1` and `seq 3`. Confirmed in the store (`jq` over `hv/board.json`), not only in the rendered view. Devbin letter D, found by devbin/vc and confirmed by devbin/dc.

Found by devbin migrating its boards on Intent 3.0.3 (`d24487079`), sent through intent/vc on hv's routing, and ruled by hv on 2026-09-16 to be fixed in this release (hv decision 18). The full measurement record, with the instrument (`carry-map.sh`, driven red and green) and who measured what, is devbin `1824c75`, `intent/whiteboard/dc/.history/20260916/wb-upstream-defects-draft.md`.

**Shared cause with the other migrate carry issues filed with this one (devbin letters A, B, D, E and F):** `wb_item` is `id, node, kind, seq, text, state, archived_at, recorded_at, authored_at, updated_at`, and has no field for a board lead, a section lead, a sub-heading, a group, a table or a heading qualifier; the section a line renders under is derived from `kind`. Whether the answer is a richer model or a migrator that never coerces and reports everything it cannot carry is ruled once for all five.

Fix: multi-line structured content never goes into a one-line list item. If the migrator cannot carry the structure it reports it as uncarried, with its lines.

**CLOSED 2026-09-16, landed on vc's word at 292414661 under vc decision 20 (the louder migrator).** A table is never carried as an item. The whole block, with every line in it, is named on `uncarried:` ("a table, with any line in its block"), and the carry refuses before the first write unless `--drop-uncarried` is passed. The table survives as written in the verbatim snapshot at `.history/pre-migration/wip.md`.
